data.long_meaning: The name Kuhu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ku’, which means ‘Moon’. The name Kuhu symbolizes the gentle and soft light of the moon. This name is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her compassionate nature. The name Kuhu carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kuhu usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
